note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: DeepMind targeting a Jul 17 launch after scrapping the base model for an architectural rebuild (2M context, Deep Think Reasoning Layer); Polymarket ~71% by Jul 31. Now about a week out; still no signed launch post.
Polymarket firmed to ~92% released by Dec 31 and ~73% by Sep 30 (up from 88%/66%) after the full GPT-5.6 public rollout cleared the near-term slate.
Manifold prices a next-gen Opus / Claude 5 flagship at 99% before Oct 1; Opus cadence has been roughly monthly.
Grok 4.5 shipped Jul 8; a numbered Grok 5 is expected further out with no clean dated market yet.
Mensch confirmed a new open-weight model family entering July early access with research, gov and industry partners; specs undisclosed.
